summary: 2026 WEC Hypercar entry (#12/#38 Cadillac V-Series.R). Front placements are the three brands carried in the team name - Cadillac, Hertz and JOTA - per the repo's WEC convention (team title/name brands mapped to front). Partners from the team's own partners page (jotasport.com 'Our Partners' strip): Mobil 1, HRX, Bollé Safety, BRADY and Singer, plus Michelin as the entry's tyre partner per the official FIA WEC entry sheet (and the Michelin logo also appears in the partners strip). Every logo in the partners strip is accounted for: the strip also shows a 'Hertz Racing Gold' logo (a Hertz sub-brand, counted under hertz), a '13 podiums in 13 years at the 24 Hours of Le Mans' achievement badge (podium-13.png, not a sponsor) and an FIA championship logo (fia-mono-3.png, not a sponsor). sponsorsComplete stays false because the partners page presents the strip as 'some of the biggest global brands including' - it does not claim to list every partner.
